# DeGigamon Full Documentation & Reference

> Complete technical catalog, dossier archive, threat modeling rules, and architecture specification for DeGigamon.

## Platform Identity
- Name: DeGigamon
- Web URL: https://degigamon.org
- Source Code: https://github.com/simple/degigamon
- Purpose: Open-source, client-side, zero-telemetry alternative to PrivacyPack.org.
- Target Audience: Privacy advocates, security professionals, open-source developers, and mainstream consumers seeking practical digital sovereignty.

## Architectural Guarantees
1. Zero Telemetry: No Google Analytics, Plausible, PostHog, or tracking beacons.
2. Zero Cookies: No HTTP cookies or session tracking.
3. 100% Client-Side Computation: State is computed in React 19 / TypeScript inside browser memory.
4. Stateless Sharing: Stack configurations are serialized into standard RFC 3986 URL hash fragments (`#pack=...`), which are never sent over HTTP request headers to hosting servers.
5. High-Resolution Canvas Card Generation: Locally rendered PNG comparison cards using HTML5 Canvas with vector graphics and dynamic grid distribution.

## Complete 24 Category Index & Criteria
Each category replaces a corporate monolith with verified software:
1. Mail: Gmail, Outlook -> Proton Mail, Tuta Mail, Mailbox.org, Posteo, SimpleLogin.
2. Search: Google Search, Bing -> DuckDuckGo, Brave Search, Kagi, SearXNG, Startpage.
3. Browser: Chrome, Edge, Safari -> Firefox, LibreWolf, Mullvad Browser, Brave, Tor Browser.
4. Mobile OS: Stock Android, iOS -> GrapheneOS, CalyxOS, LineageOS.
5. Desktop OS: Windows, macOS -> Debian, Arch Linux, Fedora, Linux Mint, Qubes OS.
6. Cloud Storage: Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox -> Proton Drive, Nextcloud, Filen.
7. Photos: Google Photos, Apple Photos, Amazon Photos -> Ente Photos, Immich, Nextcloud Memories.
8. Maps: Google Maps, Apple Maps, Waze -> Organic Maps, OsmAnd.
9. Passwords: Google Passwords, Apple Keychain, LastPass -> Bitwarden, Vaultwarden, KeePassXC.
10. Two-Factor Authentication: Google Authenticator -> Aegis Authenticator, 2FAS, Ente Auth.
11. Notes: Google Keep, Apple Notes, OneNote -> Obsidian, Joplin, Standard Notes.
12. Messaging: WhatsApp, Messenger, iMessage -> Signal, SimpleX Chat, Session, Matrix/Element.
13. Social: Instagram, Facebook, X -> Mastodon, Pixelfed, Lemmy, Bluesky.
14. Video: YouTube -> NewPipe, FreeTube, PeerTube, Jellyfin.
15. Office: Google Docs, Microsoft 365 -> LibreOffice, CryptPad, OnlyOffice.
16. Keyboards: Gboard, SwiftKey -> FUTO Keyboard, HeliBoard, FlorisBoard.
17. DNS: Google DNS, ISP DNS -> Quad9, NextDNS, Pi-hole, AdGuard Home.
18. AI Assistant: Google Gemini, ChatGPT, Meta AI -> Local Ollama, Venice AI, DuckDuckGo AI.
19. App Store: Google Play Store, App Store -> F-Droid, Aurora Store, Obtainium.
20. Analytics: Google Analytics, Meta Pixel -> Plausible Analytics, Umami.
21. Smart Home: Google Home, Amazon Alexa -> Home Assistant.
22. Remote Desktop: TeamViewer, AnyDesk -> RustDesk.
23. Payments: Google Pay, Apple Pay -> Physical Cash, Monero (XMR).
24. VPN: Logging Commercial VPNs -> Mullvad VPN, Proton VPN, IVPN, WireGuard Self-Hosted.
